name: Spades
description: Classic 4-player partnership trick-taking. Two teams (N+S vs E+W), 13 cards each. Each player BIDS how many of the 13 tricks they'll take. Spades are always trump. Make your team's combined bid → score 10× the bid plus 1 per overtrick ("bag"). Miss your bid → lose 10× the bid. Bid 0 for a NIL (±100 to your team). Every 10 bags = −100 penalty. First team to the target score wins.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Spades module cycles bid → trick play → scoring internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A Spades player. Bids tricks each hand and plays cards in clockwise order.

properties.name: hand
properties.description: Cards currently in hand (hidden from opponents).

actions.name: bid
actions.description: BID STAGE — declare the number of tricks (0–13) you'll take this hand. REQUIRED `amount`: integer 0 through 13. 0 is a NIL (brave: ±100 to your team). EXAMPLE: bid(amount=4).

actions.name: play_card
actions.description: PLAY STAGE — play one card from your hand on your turn. REQUIRED `card`: the EXACT card string. RULES: must follow led suit if possible; can't LEAD spades until broken; the 2 of clubs leads the first trick. EXAMPLE: play_card(card="A♠").

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. Signal to your partner, needle opponents, or just react to a play.

personas.persona_text: Disciplined partner. Bids accurately, plays straight tight Spades — values the bid, hates bags.
goals: Hit the combined team bid exactly.

personas.persona_text: Aggressive bidder. Loves big bids and Nil shots; tries to bait opponents into setting themselves.
goals: Bid big when the hand justifies it.

personas.persona_text: Quiet supporter. Plays around partner's bid; sandbags when bags are safe and dumps high cards when set risk is high.
Wildcard. Mixes safe play with the occasional speculative Nil. Hates being predictable.
goals: Threaten Nil to confuse the bid count.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Total Players
runtime_parameters.description: Spades is strictly 4 players in 2 fixed teams.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.spades.target_score
runtime_parameters.label: Target Score
runtime_parameters.description: Match ends when any team reaches this score. Lower = shorter matches; 500 is classic.
